import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel
from PySide6.QtCore import QItemSelectionModel
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QAbstractItemView
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.FileListView(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
control.setHeaderText("Attachments")
model = QStandardItemModel(control)
roles = fluentqt.FileListView.DataRole
states = fluentqt.FileListView.Status
for name, detail, state, progress, retryable in [
    ("brand-guidelines.pdf", "2.4 MB · Ready to use", states.Ready, 1.0, False),
    ("product-shot.png", "3.6 / 5.8 MB · Uploading", states.Uploading, 0.62, False),
    ("release-notes.pdf", "Connection lost · Retry when ready", states.Rejected, 0.0, True),
]:
    item = QStandardItem(name)
    item.setData(detail, roles.MetadataRole)
    item.setData(state, roles.StatusRole)
    item.setData(progress, roles.ProgressRole)
    item.setData(retryable, roles.RetryableRole)
    model.appendRow(item)
control.setModel(model)
control.setCurrentIndex(model.index(0, 0))
